title: Repeat Late-Change Surcharge — Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery
content:
**Surcharge for earlier late-change fees.** On a customer's reschedule of a Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery appointment under **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, a surcharge is set by the late-change fees standing on the order, that is the late-change fees charged on the order less refunds of them, measured against the program's late cancellation fee, which for Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery is 49.00 (every other program's late cancellation fee is 0.00):

| Late-change fees standing on the order | Surcharge |
|---|---|
| at the program's late cancellation fee or more (49.00 or more) | 20.00 |
| above zero but below that fee (above 0.00 and below 49.00) | 10.00 |
| otherwise (nothing standing) | none |

**Both sides of each threshold.** Standing fees of 49.00 carry 20.00 and of 48.99 carry 10.00; standing fees of 0.01 carry 10.00 and of 0.00 carry nothing. A late-change fee fully refunded no longer stands.
